野人為 ASUS CES 2025 展覽打造最終預告，以時光流轉展現筆電強大續航力。
⁡
突破時間限制的筆電續航力，一次充電，持久運行，讓靈感與效率不再受電量束縛。無論是工作、創作或娛樂，隨時隨地暢行無阻，陪你走得更遠，成就更多可能。
⁡
Laptop Battery Life That Defies Time
One charge, endless power. Unleash your creativity and productivity without the limits of battery life. Whether for work, creation, or entertainment, stay unstoppable anytime, anywhere—empowering you to go further and achieve more.
⁡

輕如雲朵的 Zenbook，隨行無負擔，極致輕薄設計，強大效能兼備，無論何處皆能高效工作與創作。
⁡

Beyond the horizon of time.
HUAWEI WATCH 5 ID VIDEO/ DIRECTOR'S CUT

This one had us jumping between shots of black holes, drifting planets, and tight watch macros. After hours? Quantum physics podcasts. Safe to say, it wasn’t your average gig.

We framed the Huawei Watch 5 as a tiny spacecraft floating through deep space — a way to tell its design story through exploration. The film balances fast, punchy sequences with slower, atmospheric shots, keeping the pace unpredictable but deliberate. Inside-to-outside transitions play with the idea of tech-meets-elegance, while close-ups linger on textures, materials, and those super clean details you’d usually expect in a sci-fi flick.
